proposal.summary: Update two existing memories to prevent repeated retrieval of absent fields and keep semantic audits aligned with the requested column. Existing entries already cover honest discovery logging and fetch-failure recovery.

edits.title: Separate quote membership from factual support
edits.content: A quote occurring in model-rendered fetch output does not by itself establish that it is a source quotation or supports the complete claim. Distinguish source excerpts from renderer summaries, labels and assembled passages; do not reject a genuine source heading merely because the tool renders it. Before recording a positive constraint verdict, verify the entity, applicable time period and every substantive component of the value. Keep extraction and audit criteria aligned with the requested column: an explicit national descriptor can support nationality without establishing legal citizenship or dual citizenship. Birthplace, ancestry, workplace, flags and unlinked country labels are insufficient substitutes. Treat reviewer findings as hypotheses to resolve against supplied evidence, not instructions to strengthen the task's requirements. For affiliations, distinguish separately affiliated institutions from parenthetical parent-organization descriptions. When sources support different parts of a composite claim, retain an internal claim-to-excerpt mapping and respect the output contract rather than stitching excerpts into a purported verbatim quote. Recheck semantic support after final mutations, even when schema, substring and coverage checks pass.

edits.title: Probe source availability and track field coverage
edits.content: When prior run evidence reports uniform fetch failures on a host, test one or two returned URLs before committing another large batch to that host. Recheck availability rather than assuming a permanent outage. After a uniformly failed batch, inspect saved search hits for authoritative alternative hosts and probe one or two URLs before expanding fetching or repeating discovery searches. Preserve search results and successful fetched text, track failed URLs, and avoid unchanged failed batches. Changing to same-host PDFs does not establish recovery; ordinary URLs and unusual suffixes both failed, so the cause remains unknown. Treat FETCH_FAILED as unavailable evidence, never citation text. Track field coverage separately from fetch status: a successful retrieval can explicitly report that a requested field is absent. Consult those absence notes before another focused fetch; seek a different source unless there is a concrete reason to believe the earlier retrieval omitted relevant material. Preserve each successful retrieval separately, including its focus and field limitations, so later failures or narrower results do not overwrite usable evidence. Expand only after inspecting probe results; proposed fallback calls are not evidence of recovery.

additional_candidates.description: Audits temporarily substituted citizenship for nationality and treated an organizational parenthetical as a missing affiliation; later reviews corrected these interpretations.
Eight focused nationality fetches revisited pages whose saved extractions already reported no explicit nationality or citizenship, and all eight confirmed absence.
Preserving retrieval versions and validating targeted patches supported recovery without discarding earlier usable quotations.

decisions.reason: All 29 occurrences were considered. The first four are fallback searches that yielded no new names after initial discovery; the remaining nine nationality, eleven gap, and five targeted searches investigated already known entities. Their empty discovery records are consistent with that purpose, and several yielded useful evidence despite no entity growth. Entry 0 already requires inspection before logging and explicitly permits honest empty records for verification. Its repeated signal counts therefore do not establish consistently bad behavior or justify suppressing legitimate verification searches.

All 26 failures were considered: nine initial same-host failures, six failures in the expanded alternative-source batch, seven in nationality retrieval, two in gap retrieval, and two in final targeted retrieval. These include repeat failures for the LIGO and AP URLs and a later failure for an APS URL that had previously succeeded. Recovery through successful alternative hosts is visible. Entry 1's current version already addresses prior-host probes, failed-URL tracking, preservation of successful evidence, and avoiding unsupported explanations for failures; its usage records concern the earlier version. No additional failure-specific rule is needed, and passing checks alone are not the reason for declining.

The second audit explicitly demanded citizenship evidence for nationality cells, while later prompts restored the distinction and accepted explicit national descriptors. A post-patch affiliation audit also demanded a parent organization, then a focused resolution retained the supported institutions. These recovered review errors expose ambiguity in entry 3's combined nationality/citizenship guidance. Clarifying the existing memory preserves its useful semantic checks without treating reviewer assertions or deterministic citation membership as factual authority.

Earlier saved extractions explicitly reported absent nationality/citizenship for all eight revisited announcement pages. Fetch records 49–56 and their trajectory results confirm that every subsequent nationality-only retrieval repeated that absence. Later alternative-source searches supplied the missing evidence. Extend entry 1 from transport availability to field coverage, allowing justified focused retries while avoiding this repeated unproductive batch.

The run preserved page_versions, checked quotations against individual saved retrievals, and validated targeted patches before applying them. Final checks passed, although semantic review remained necessary. Entry 2 already covers saved-evidence repair, complete-value support and validation before mutation; retrieval preservation is also retained in the availability update. A separate skill would duplicate this coverage, so the edit budget favors the two concrete failure-mode clarifications.
